text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arabs warn against Israeli policy in the region.
- Syrian Prime Minister Mahmoud Zu'bi heads a meeting of the higher council for companies to follow up irrigation projects.
- Israeli aggression in south Lebanon continues and a prisoner reveals methods of torture.
- A tremor in Cyprus felt in Syria but no casualties.
- An English company holds a Syrian ship over differences with Syrian oil company al-Furat concerning imports.

- Syrian Vice-President Abdel-Halim Khaddam conveyed a message to Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani from Syrian President Hafez al-Assad on regional developments and Arab-Israeli conflict. Khaddam says: "Our ties are strong and nothing will affect them, and enforcing them in all spheres is in the interest of the region."
- Lebanese President Elias Hrawi says Beirut is keen to maintain cooperation with Syria.
